messages.主力になる人格を引いて、物語を始めよう。理想の組み合わせを揃える必要はない。: Pull an Identity you want as a main fighter, then begin the story. You do not need a perfect lineup.
messages.リセマラは必須ではない。迷ったら、主力候補1体を目安に。: Rerolling is optional. If unsure, aim for 1 main-fighter candidate.
messages.多くの人格・E.G.Oは、遊びながら集める自我の破片で交換できる。序盤を楽にした: Many Identities and E.G.O can be obtained with Egoshards earned while playing. Reroll if you want an easier start, or begin when you pull an Identity you like. Dispenser availability has timing and eligibility restrictions, so check how to obtain the Identity you want first.
messages.使いたい主力候補を1体: 1 main-fighter candidate you want to use
messages.下の候補の使い方と注意点を読み、育てたい1体が引けたら終了の目安。好きな人格で始: Read the candidates' practical notes and cautions below. Pulling 1 you want to develop is a reasonable stopping point. Starting with an Identity you simply like is also valid.
messages.もう少し狙うなら: If you want to aim a little higher
messages.同時に出撃できる人格が増えると編成を組みやすい。候補全員や特定の組み合わせが揃う: Having more Identities that can deploy together makes team building easier. You do not need to keep rerolling until you have every candidate or a specific combination.
messages.同じ囚人の人格は同時出撃できない。ファウストの人格を2種類引いても、出撃できるフ: You cannot deploy multiple Identities of the same Sinner at once. Pulling 2 different Faust Identities still lets you deploy only 1 Faust. Duplicate copies of the same Identity do not increase the number of units you can deploy either.
messages.新しいシーズンの人格を中心に、攻守の役割と育てた後の強みから選んだ各囚人の候補。: Candidates for each Sinner, mainly from newer seasons, chosen for their offensive or defensive roles and strengths after upgrading. They are listed in Sinner order, not ranked by strength. You do not need them all.
messages.時点のS8。抽出ごとに排出対象が異なるため、狂気を使う前に「提供一覧」で候補の名: during Season 8. Each Extraction has a different pool, so check the candidate's name in its offering list before spending Lunacy. Not every candidate is necessarily available from the New Manager's Welcome Extraction.
messages.人格名を選ぶと性能・使い方へ。「理由」でこのページの詳しい説明へ移動。: Select an Identity's name for its stats and guide, or Reasons for its detailed explanation on this page.
messages.支援や変身を得意とする候補には、仲間や準備が必要な場合もある。選んだ理由と注意点: Candidates focused on support or transformations may need teammates or setup. Read the reasons and cautions before deciding to stop.
messages.開催時に狙いたい限定人格の候補。火力だけでなく、回復や編成への貢献も見て6人格を: Limited Identities to consider while the event is running. These 6 were chosen for healing and team contributions as well as damage. They are listed in Sinner order; you do not need them all.
messages.ヴァルプルギスの夜の開催中に、引く抽出の提供一覧に載っている場合に狙おう。開催外: Only aim for these during Walpurgis Night if they appear in the offering list of the Extraction you will use. Outside the event, leave them out of your reroll targets and choose from the regular candidates.
messages.気になる囚人の説明を開いて確認しよう。性能は同期化Ⅳを基準にしており、入手直後か: Expand the explanation for a Sinner you are interested in. These descriptions assume Uptie Ⅳ; not every part of the playstyle is available immediately after obtaining the Identity.
messages.使う前に知っておきたいこと: What to know before using it
messages.性能・使い方を詳しく見る →: View stats and the full guide →
messages.人格は普段の戦闘で使うスキルを決める。E.G.Oは資源を消費して使う特殊な技で、: Identities determine the skills you use in ordinary combat. E.G.O are special skills that consume resources and also require suitable team building and upgrades. When rerolling, first check whether you have an Identity that can serve as a main fighter.
messages.E.G.Oとのセット引きは必須にしない: Do not require a matching E.G.O pull
messages.有用なE.G.Oが一緒に出たらうれしいが、それだけを理由に主力人格のいる結果を捨: A useful E.G.O is a welcome bonus, but its absence is not a reason to discard an account with a good main-fighter Identity. Check the corresponding Sinner's pages for ways to use any E.G.O you obtain.
messages.スマホ版の未連携アカウントで行う流れ。既に遊んでいるアカウントを削除しないよう、: These steps are for an unlinked account on mobile. Check which account you are managing so you do not delete progress you already want to keep.
messages.スマホ版で未連携の状態から開始する: Start with an unlinked mobile account
messages.チュートリアルを進めるかスキップする。結果を決めるまでは外部アカウントと連携しな: Play or skip the tutorial. Do not link an external account until you have chosen the result you want to keep.
messages.配布を受け取り、抽出の提供一覧を確認する: Claim starting rewards and check the Extraction pool
messages.新人管理人記念抽出などの対象・必要な狂気・確定枠を確認する。狙う人格が載っていな: Check the available items, Lunacy cost, and guarantees for the New Manager's Welcome Extraction or other Extractions. If your target Identity is not listed, repeating that Extraction will not produce it.
messages.抽出して、終了ラインと比べる: Extract and compare the result with your stopping point
messages.使いたい主力がいるか、囚人が偏っていないかを見る。終了するなら、削除せずアカウン: Check whether you have a main fighter you want to use and whether your pulls are concentrated on the same Sinner. If you are finished, protect the account instead of deleting it.
messages.やり直す場合のみ、未連携データを削除する: Delete unlinked data only if you want to start over
messages.「設定 → 環境設定 → アカウント → アカウント削除」へ進む。画面上の対象・: Go to Settings → Preferences → Account → Delete Account. Read the displayed account details and deletion conditions, and confirm that this is the temporary reroll account before proceeding.
messages.新人管理人記念抽出は狂気1600で20回、000人格またはE.G.Oが1つ確定。: The New Manager's Welcome Extraction offers 20 pulls for 1600 Lunacy, guaranteeing 1 000 Identity or E.G.O. Excluding the initial download, a reroll takes roughly 1–2 minutes, depending on your device, connection, and starting rewards. Check starting Lunacy and guarantees in the game before Extracting.
messages.Steam版は起動時にアカウントが連携されるため、スマホの未連携データと同じ手順: The Steam version links an account on startup, so you cannot reroll with the same procedure as an unlinked mobile account. If you want to play on PC, one option is to choose a result on mobile and link it afterward. Always check which progress will be retained when linking. Linked accounts have a deletion waiting period; read the conditions on the deletion screen.
messages.終わったら、物語へ: Once you are done, begin the story
messages.続けるデータを決めたら、ゲーム内の案内に従って連携し、ユーザーIDを控えておこう: Once you have chosen the account to keep, follow the in-game linking instructions and save your user ID.
messages.主力を育てながらストーリーを進める: Progress the story while upgrading your main fighters
messages.引いた人格のレベル・同期化を少しずつ上げる。足りない役割は初期人格や00人格も使: Gradually improve your Identities' levels and Uptie. Use starting Identities and 00 Identities to fill missing roles. The beginner guide explains daily activities and Egoshard exchanges.
messages.初心者ガイドで、次にすることを見る →: See what to do next in the beginner guide →
messages.育成・採光・鏡ダンジョン・交換を順番に案内。: A step-by-step guide to upgrades, Luxcavations, Mirror Dungeons, and the Dispenser.
messages.【リンバス】リセマラガイド｜おすすめ人格と終了ライン｜Limbus Assist: Reroll Guide: Recommended Identities and When to Stop | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)のリセマラガイド。おすすめの人格・E.G: A Limbus Company reroll guide covering recommended Identities and E.G.O, the reasons for each choice, when to stop, and the reroll procedure.
